recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source change is needed for FHIR-5940 unless a future Pharmacy decision intentionally narrows Dosage.dose[x] or MedicationStatement.dosage.
issue_request: FHIR-5940 was a Published/Persuasive Pharmacy change request from the DSTU1 cycle asking that MedicationStatement.quantity allow either a Quantity or a Range because the reported quantity given may not always be known exactly. The resolution required support for dosage.quantity ranges, for example taking 1-2 tablets.
initial_application: Historical commit 857c4c94c0ccaf8f6174da0b8540f6d9b387672b, subject '#5940, #7513', changed MedicationStatement.dosage.quantity to MedicationStatement.dosage.quantity[x], changed the type from SimpleQuantity to SimpleQuantity | Range, and updated MedicationStatement examples to use choice element names.
additional_context: FHIR-7513 is the same change family and independently asked that MedicationStatement allow dose ranges. Current R6 source has since been refactored so MedicationStatement.dosage uses DosageDetails; DosageDetails.step.component is Dosage; and Dosage.doseAndRate.dose[x] permits Range | SimpleQuantity | Expression. A current MedicationStatement example contains doseRange. Zulip and Confluence searches found no relevant conflicting community record.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the active current source already permits MedicationStatement dose ranges and no corrective source edit is needed.
